subject: reasoning
question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is NOT allowed)

(51, 34, 85)

(67, 42, 109)
solution:
The logic followed here is: **Sum of 1st + 2nd = 3rd number**.

For, (51, 34, 85)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee8da5edca7391e299bbd116b9a3b020233d546177d900ce6b006f4cff2e8147.png] 

For, (67, 42, 109)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4851552bf4eece9451e7d1e3459872d389d2ba2e1d69a249ab94800396cfb61b.png] 

Similarly, for (73, 38, 111)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0a853222aa9dfc04cf55bc2ddd75b24edf1e5904f93ae10d56b21cfe2f09028.png] 

So, *The set in which the numbers are related in the same way as the numbers of the following set is (73,38,111)*.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**

 
• Do not break down the numbers into consecutive digits.
